desc:
Drupal theme edits and Twig fixes change the layout, templates and styling of your site without touching your content. Ecom Swift LLC makes each change on a staging copy, so visitors see nothing until you approve the preview.

## What are Drupal theme edits?

Drupal theme edits are targeted changes to the part of your site that controls how it looks: Twig templates, CSS, theme settings and the arrangement of blocks. Twig is the template language Drupal uses to turn content into HTML. Edits might fix a broken mobile menu, restyle a block, rework a header or add a new page template for one content type.

Theme work is separate from content work. Your articles and settings stay as they are, while the presentation around them changes.

## Why small theme problems deserve attention

A theme issue is rarely just cosmetic. A menu that does not open on a phone blocks navigation for many visitors. A button that sits off screen hides your main action. A layout that breaks after a Drupal update makes the whole organization look neglected.

Left alone, these issues multiply, because each workaround adds code that later causes new problems. Fixing them cleanly, in the right template or stylesheet, prevents that build up.

## How theme fixes improve results

Cleaner layout means visitors find what they need and act on it. A working mobile menu keeps phone users moving through the site. A well styled form or banner gives your offer the attention it deserves. Removing unused styles reduces what the browser must download, which helps pages load faster.

For your team, tidy theme code lowers the cost of every future change. A developer opening a cleaned theme can work in an hour on something that would otherwise take a day.

## What good Drupal theme work includes

- Changes made in the proper template, stylesheet or theme setting, not with temporary hacks.
- A staging copy for all work, with a preview link for you.
- Checks on phone, tablet and desktop, and in several browsers.
- Overrides placed in your theme or a child theme, never in core or contributed modules.
- Template suggestions for new page or content layouts.
- Reusable components, so a design element is built once and used many times.
- Dead CSS and unused code removed in larger packages.
- Careful testing of menus, forms and block placement.
- A plain list of every file changed.
- A short note for future editors on how the new parts work.

## What we do

You send a list of what needs to change, ideally with screenshots and page addresses. We confirm each item, copy your site to staging and make the edits there. We test every change on phone and desktop, and for larger packages in three browsers.

The Basic package covers a small set of fixes. Standard allows more edits, one new page or content template and a menu or header rework. Premium covers a larger theme update with new reusable components, custom block styling and a code cleanup. You review the preview, ask for adjustments, and approve. Then we apply the same changes to the live site and check it again.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Write each requested change as a separate line with a page address.
- Include screenshots, especially of mobile problems.
- Tell us which theme you use, such as Olivero, Claro or a custom one.
- Test the preview on a real phone.
- Keep the staging copy until you are satisfied.

**Avoid:**
- Asking for edits directly on the live site.
- Changing theme files by hand while we work on the same ones.
- Adding code snippets from random forums to your theme.
- Editing parent theme files instead of using a child theme.
- Bundling a full redesign into a list of small fixes.

## Who this is for

This suits a site owner whose layout broke after an update and who needs it fixed without a full project. It suits a marketing team that needs a new landing page template, and an organization whose header or menu no longer works well on phones.

## What we need from you

Send the list of changes, the site address and a note on which theme and Drupal setup you use. We prefer to work from a staging copy, and we can create one if you do not have it. We work as a developer user in your account and never ask for passwords. We will confirm the list before we begin.
